title: Build, test and hand over a stock and sales app

say: Build, test and hand over a stock and sales app.
This is the video for module two of No-Code App Development.
In this module you build one real app. For example, Esther runs an agro-input shop in Makurdi, with two sales staff. She wants to stop counting bags every evening.

panel.heading: Esther's agro-input shop app
items: Warn the owner when stock runs low

say: Her app will track products, deliveries and sales, warn her when stock is low, and be tested and documented so someone else can run it. It all works on AppSheet's free prototyping stage.

panel.heading: Esther's agro-input shop app
items: Warn the owner when stock runs low

say: Most early problems come from messy sheets. AppSheet reads each tab as a table, with one header row on top.

panel.heading: Prepare the sheet properly
items: One table per tab: Products, Stock In, Sales
Exactly one header row in row 1
No merged cells, totals rows or blank rows
An ID column first in every tab

say: Remove merged cells and totals rows. Esther deleted a TOTAL row at the bottom of her Sales tab, because AppSheet would read it as a sale.

say: After the sheet, check every column. Keys get the initial value UNIQUEID(), and are hidden. Dates start as TODAY(). Sold By records USEREMAIL().

say: Logic is written as expressions, short formulas with column names in square brackets. Add a virtual column called Current Stock. NPK starts the month with 40 bags.
SELECT and SUM add every delivery for this product: 25 bags.
Then subtract every sale: 52 bags.
The app shows 13 bags left without anyone counting. With a reorder level of 15, NPK shows Reorder in red.

panel.heading: Stock is calculated, never typed
panel.rule: 13 is at or below the reorder level of 15: time to reorder.

say: Make Qty and Product required.

cards.d: Qty and Product must be filled, so no sale is saved without them.
Qty above 0 and no more than Current Stock. Add a clear error message.
Unit Price copies the product price at the time of sale. No retyping.

say: Add a Valid If, so quantity must be above 0 and no more than the stock. Add a message like, only 13 bags left, so staff know what went wrong.

say: A bot watches for an event, then runs steps by itself. Here the event is a new row in Sales.

panel.heading: A low-stock bot
items: Condition: stock at or below reorder level

say: The condition checks the product's stock against its reorder level. If true, it emails Esther the product name and stock.

panel.heading: A low-stock bot
items: Condition: stock at or below reorder level

say: Record test sales until the condition is met, and confirm the email arrives. Keep heavy formulas few, because they slow the app as tables grow.

panel.heading: A low-stock bot
items: Condition: stock at or below reorder level
panel.rule: A bot fires only when the event and condition are both true.

say: For example, Amina is finishing Esther's app. She writes 14 test cases, including selling exactly the last bag, and entering zero or blanks. She runs them as a sales staff test user.

panel.heading: Amina's test script
items: Include edge cases and wrong entries

say: 3 fail. A quantity of 0 was saved, two products could share a name, and staff could edit the opening stock. She fixes each one.

panel.heading: Amina's test script
items: Include edge cases and wrong entries

say: Then she reruns all 14, because fixes can break other things. All pass, and the test log goes into the handover pack.

panel.heading: Amina's test script
items: Include edge cases and wrong entries
panel.rule: After any fix, rerun every case, not just the failures.

say: Require sign-in, and use a Users table with roles so only the owner changes prices. Anyone with edit access to the Google Sheet can change data, so share it only with the owner and builder.

cards.d: Share with named staff emails. Only the owner changes prices and stock. Limit who edits the sheet.
Collect only what you need. Never collect BVN, NIN or card details in a no-code app.
Days offline can overwrite others' changes. Staff sync at least daily.

say: Customer phone numbers are personal data. The Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 expects you to collect only what you need and keep it secure.

say: AppSheet works offline, but a phone offline for days can overwrite other people's changes when it syncs. Test it in airplane mode.

say: To remember. Clean the sheet and check every column. Calculate stock, never type it. Block bad entries. Rerun all tests after fixes. And deliver a handover pack, so someone other than you can keep the app alive.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Clean sheets first; check every column
Valid If and Required stop bad entries
Rerun every test after a fix
Handover pack: model, rules, users, costs, tests

say: Your tasks: build the first version from a clean sheet, add the logic and the low-stock bot, then test, secure and document your app.
